d:
From a young girl in Italy to one of the most influential political figures in India, Sonia Gandhi's journey is a story of love, loss, family, politics and unexpected responsibilities.
In this episode of Kissa, we explore the life of Sonia Gandhi — her early years in Italy, her meeting and marriage with Rajiv Gandhi, and her entry into the Nehru-Gandhi family. We look at the personal tragedies she experienced, including the loss of her first child, and her relationship with Indira Gandhi and Sanjay Gandhi.
